layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Bento Tetris layout for metrics with compact cardless borders, generous p-6/p-8 containers
layout_and_spacing.card_style: 1px tactile border (border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-800) with subtle ambient shadow (shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow)
layout_and_spacing.header_style: Sticky top with glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md bg-stone-50/85 dark:bg-stone-950/85 border-b border-stone-200/80 dark:border-stone-800/80 z-40

dashboard_stock_center.rule: Stock center details MUST appear ONLY when the Stock Center column/card is clicked.
dashboard_stock_center.owner_rank_targets: Owner users have inline editable controls for Rank Targets with direct save capability.
dashboard_stock_center.auto_downloads: Every PDF/Excel export button MUST trigger an instant automatic file download without navigating away.

stock_awal_flow.confirmation_popup: Saving Stock Awal triggers a confirmation modal with 'Revise/Back' and 'Submit' options.
stock_awal_flow.submit_action: Submitting records photo timestamp/data and opens WhatsApp details with reviewed payload.

dashboard_stock_center.stock_rider_total: Stock Rider view MUST display the aggregated Total Product Stock prominent metric.

production_and_inventory.material_guard: Production stock module MUST enforce raw material check: cannot create/produce a product without required raw materials.

purchase_page.ai_extraction_step: Includes AI Receipt/Invoice Extraction first (upload proof/receipt image/PDF, auto-parse items, price, vendor).
purchase_page.unlimited_material_lines: Dynamic editable list of materials with live cost preview.
purchase_page.recipe_hpp_sync: If purchase material price differs from current recipe cost, option to update recipe/HPP dynamically.

pos_redesign.compact_cart_trigger: Positioned at lower-left beneath cart info displaying nominal chosen items count & total value.
pos_redesign.bottom_sheet_payment: Tapping the compact cart icon opens a smooth bottom-up animated payment sheet drawer.

steps: 1. Cashier selects items and chooses QRIS payment method
2. Rider QR code displays on screen
3. Cashier verifies payment and presses 'Konfirmasi Pembayaran Diterima' button
5. Optional WhatsApp reviewed composer popup opens with pre-formatted receipt message

admin_deposit_tab.icon_style: POS-like wallet/cart icon with active indicators

image_urls.description: Specialty coffee cart barista crafting espresso outdoors
Barista extracting espresso shot on a commercial machine
Micro coffee cart kiosk with specialty roast menu

testing_guidelines.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based, e.g., data-testid='stock-center-details-modal', data-testid='qris-confirm-payment-btn', data-testid='purchase-ai-extract-btn'

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always update web title to 'SI FOUR A.M | Coffee Cart Operating System'.
Every interactive element and key metric block MUST have a explicit data-testid attribute.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on headers or dialog overlays. Use glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md with solid background opacity.
Ensure all PDF and Excel download buttons execute automatic file generation/download without page refreshes.
Follow strict color contrast APCA standards with warm artisan palette neutrals (#120F0D / #FDFBF7).
